systems.baseline: lexical-v1: original token-overlap retriever (frozen in evaluations/lexical-v1.mjs)
systems.current: Current docs/engine.mjs retriever on its own
systems.assistant: docs/assistant.mjs question router used by the workspace (search plus listing handlers)

evaluation_type: Development diagnostics; neither set is an independent held-out benchmark

sets.development: evaluations/cases.json — 18 queries visible while the original baseline was built
sets.challenge: evaluations/challenge-cases.json — 24 paraphrased, channel-scoped and unanswerable queries written and committed before retrieval changes, by the same AI-assisted author
sets.usecases: evaluations/usecase-cases.json — 24 questions with expected handling, committed before the router was built

limitations: Small author-written synthetic corpus; no external validity.
Both query sets were written by the project author with AI assistance, not independent annotators.
Retrieval metrics do not measure whether an answer is semantically correct or useful.
Abstention is decided by retrieval only: questions sharing vocabulary with the corpus can still return records.
Live LLM accuracy, latency and cost have not been measured.
